import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_CONST = 1000000007L;
    static long number;
    static int length, base, totalSum, position, digitsArr[] = new int[110];

    static class Mat {
        int[][] mat = new int[35][35];

        Mat() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    mat[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Mat multiply(Mat other) {
            Mat result = new Mat();
            for (int k = 0; k <= base; k++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
                    if (mat[i][k] != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                            if (other.mat[k][j] != 0) {
                                long temp = (1L * mat[i][k] * other.mat[k][j]) + result.mat[i][j];
                                result.mat[i][j] = (int) (temp % MOD_CONST);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static Mat answerMat = new Mat();
    static Mat[][] sMat = new Mat[75][35];
    static Mat[][] prefixMat = new Mat[75][35];
    static Mat[][] suffixMat = new Mat[75][35];

    static void addModulo(int[] x, int y, int m) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= m) x[0] -= m;
    }

    static void parseNumber(long num) {
        long temp = num;
        length = 0;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digitsArr[++length] = (int) (temp % base);
            temp /= base;
        }
        // reverse the digitsArr from 1 to length
        for (int i = 1; i <= length / 2; i++) {
            int tmp = digitsArr[i];
            digitsArr[i] = digitsArr[length - i + 1];
            digitsArr[length - i + 1] = tmp;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        number = sc.nextLong();
        base = sc.nextInt();

        parseNumber(number);

        for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
            sMat[0][i] = new Mat();
            for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                sMat[0][i].mat[j][j] = 1;
                sMat[0][i].mat[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < base; j++) {
                prefixMat[i - 1][j] = sMat[i - 1][j];
                suffixMat[i - 1][j] = sMat[i - 1][j];
            }
            prefixMat[i - 1][0] = sMat[i - 1][0];
            suffixMat[i - 1][base - 1] = sMat[i - 1][base - 1];

            for (int j = 1; j < base; j++) {
                prefixMat[i - 1][j] = prefixMat[i - 1][j - 1].multiply(sMat[i - 1][j]);
            }
            for (int j = base - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suffixMat[i - 1][j] = sMat[i - 1][j].multiply(suffixMat[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < base; j++) {
                if (j != 0) {
                    sMat[i][j] = suffixMat[i - 1][j].multiply(prefixMat[i - 1][j - 1]);
                } else {
                    sMat[i][j] = suffixMat[i - 1][j];
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                answerMat.mat[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }

        position = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= length; i++) {
            if (digitsArr[i] != 0) {
                int endPos = position + digitsArr[i] - 1;
                if (endPos >= base) {
                    for (int j = position; j < base; j++) {
                        answerMat = answerMat.multiply(sMat[length - i][j]);
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j <= endPos - base; j++) {
                        answerMat = answerMat.multiply(sMat[length - i][j]);
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int j = position; j <= endPos; j++) {
                        answerMat = answerMat.multiply(sMat[length - i][j]);
                    }
                }
                addModulo(new int[]{position}, digitsArr[i], base);
                position += digitsArr[i];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            addModulo(new int[]{totalSum}, answerMat.mat[i][base], (int) MOD_CONST);
        }

        System.out.println(totalSum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
